# Souso

> Souso is an AI household food planner. It learns how a household eats, plans
> the week, and fills a ready-to-order basket at a Dutch supermarket (Albert
> Heijn or Jumbo). The user always checks out themselves; Souso never buys
> anything automatically.

Souso removes the weekly "what's for dinner, and what do I need to buy" mental
load. A household swipes on recipes to seed its preferences, gets an instant
first week (one recipe per day), can adjust the week by chat, and fills a
basket at AH or Jumbo in under a minute. Meal plans are grounded in a real
recipe catalogue, never hallucinated.
